City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor (Planning Commission & Staff)
1 West Manchester Boulevard

  COVID-19 PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS

Until further notice, meetings of the Inglewood Planning Commission will
be conducted pursuant to California Government Code section 54953(e),
which allows the City to use teleconferencing for members of the public to
access a meeting and to address the legislative body via a call-in option.

CALL-IN OPTION
1.  Members of the public who wish to attend the Planning Commission
Meeting of August 3, 2022 and address the Planning Commission must use the
call-in option noted below:
Instructions: Dial one of the Phone Numbers below and when prompted,
enter the Access Code:
  Phone Number: 888-251-2949 or 215-861-0694
  Access Code: 7109575#
In the event of a disruption which prevents the City from broadcasting the
meeting to the public using the call-in option, or in the event of a
disruption within the City’s control which prevents the public from
offering public comments using the call-in option, the Planning Commission
shall take no further action on items appearing on the meeting agenda
until public access to the meeting via the call-in option is restored.

ALTERNATIVE METHODS
The City also provides alternative methods for members of the public to
submit comments and/or to observe a public meeting. The following
alternative methods are provided to the public as a matter of convenience
only and the disruption in service to any alternative method does not
preclude the Planning Commission from taking further action on an agenda
item.  In the event of a disruption to any alternative method below
members of the public should use the call-in option above.
2. Submitting Comments Prior to Public Meeting: Members of the public may
choose to submit comments for consideration by the Planning Commission by
sending  them  to  Mindy  Wilcox,  AICP,  Planning  Manager  at
mwilcox@cityofinglewood.org. To ensure distribution to the members of the
Planning Commission prior to consideration of the agenda, comments must be
received prior to 12:00 P.M. on the day of the meeting. Correspondence
should indicate the meeting date and agenda item. Comments received after
12:00 P.M. and prior to the close of the public hearing will be made part
of the official public record of the meeting.
3. Viewing and Listening to the Meeting without Making Public Comments:
  On Spectrum Cable Channel 35 with audio and limited video.  Please
check with your cable provider for details
  Live online through Facebook Live, with audio and limited video at
https://www.facebook.com/cityofinglewood/

Accessibility: If you will require special accommodations due to a
disability, please contact the Planning Division Office at (310) 412-5230,
One Manchester Boulevard, 4th Floor, Inglewood, California 90301.  All
requests for accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to the day of
the hearing.
Español: "Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor
de llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

MINUTES
  INGLEWOOD PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
  WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 3, 2022

(1) PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:
The City of Inglewood Planning Commission held its Planning
Commission meeting on Wednesday, August 3, 2022, in the City
Council Chambers, on the ninth floor, of City Hall. Following the
Pledge of Allegiance by Commissioner Patrick, the meeting was
called to order at 7:01 p.m.

(2) ROLL CALL:
Present: Acting Chairwoman Aide Trejo
  Commissioner Patricia Patrick
  Commissioner David Rice
  Commissioner Cheryl Shaw-Williams
Excused
Absence: Chairman Larry Springs

Staff:  Mindy Wilcox, AICP, Planning Manager
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Senior Planner
  Bernard McCrumby, Senior Planner
  Marissa Fewell, Planner
  Angel Leon-Martell, Planner
  Christine Rivera, Assistant Planner
  Sean May, Planning Technician
  Michael Pan, Assistant City Attorney
  Cynthia Robinson, Secretary
  Via Community Phone Call Coverage:
  AT&T Conference Call Operator Rep.

(3) STAFF COMMUNICATIONS:
Ms. Mindy Wilcox, Planning Manager, announced that Chairman
Springs notified staff that he would not be attending the meeting
and has designated Commissioner Trejo to be Acting Chairwoman
tonight.  She stated that staff has revised meeting materials for
Item 6a and they have been distributed and posted online.

(4) PUBLIC COMMENTS:
None (Confirmed by AT&T Operator).

(5) MINUTES APPROVAL:
Acting Chairwoman Trejo called for a vote to approve July 6, 2022
minutes.

Motion to Approve July 6, 2022 Minutes by Commissioner Shaw-
Williams and seconded by Commissioner Patrick.

The motion passed with the following roll call vote:
Ayes:  Commissioners Rice, Commissioner Patrick, Commissioner
  Shaw-Williams and Acting Chairwoman Trejo.

(6) PUBLIC HEARINGS:

6A. ZONING CODE AMENDMENT NO. 2022-001 (ZCA-2022-001)

A public hearing to consider a request by Anand Desai for Zoning
Code  Amendment  2022-001  (ZCA-2022-001)  to  modify  height
regulations in the C-2A (Airport Commercial) Zone citywide.

Mr. Angel Leon-Martell,  Assistant  Planner,  made  the  staff
presentation.
 Inglewood Planning Commission Meeting Minutes
August 3, 2022
Acting Chairwoman Trejo asked the Planning Commission if there
were any questions for staff.

Commissioner Rice asked staff –
 Is staff measuring from the edge to the ground for the 75 feet?
 Did the FAA want buildings to stay at below 75 feet for safety?
  - Mr. Leon-Martell responded to Commissioner Rice
 Will that create a hazard for the FAA?
  - Ms. Wilcox responded to Commissioner Rice’s question.

Commissioner Patrick asked staff –
 Do you have a list of the ten cities within the Los Angeles
  region that you surveyed for height requirements?
  - Mr.  Leon-Martell  responded  to  Commissioner Patrick’s
  question.

Chairwoman Trejo asked staff –
 What is the highest height limitation that some of the other
  cities have?
  - Mr. Leon-Martell responded to Chairwoman Trejo’s question.

Chairwoman Trejo opened the floor for the Planning Commission to
address the applicant.

Chairwoman Trejo asked the applicant to give their name and talk
about their project.

The applicant did not comment on this project. Ms. Wilcox stated
the applicant intended to be on and that staff will try to reach
him.

The Planning Commission attempted to hear from the applicant but
did not get a response.

Commissioner Rice stated that he thinks that in the interest of
the public they have heard enough and he has no questions for the
applicant. He stated that he is ready to make a motion if the other
Commissioners don’t have any objection.

Chairwoman Trejo asked the Commissioners if they had any questions
for the applicant.

There were none.

Chairwoman Trejo opened the public hearing to the audience to speak
either for or against this project.

FOR / AGAINST:

None (Confirmed by the AT&T Operator).

Chairwoman Trejo closed the public hearing and called for a motion.

MOTION:

Commissioner Rice made the motion to affirm categorical exemption
EA-CE-2022-064 and adopt a resolution recommending City Council
adoption of Zoning Code Amendment ZCA-2022-001 and it was seconded
by Commissioner Shaw-Williams that Resolution No. 1936

  A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF
  THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING
  AND RECOMMENDING TO THE CITY COUNCIL FOR
  APPROVAL ZONING CODE AMENDMENT ZCA 2022-001
  TO MODIFY HEIGHT REGULATION IN THE C-2A
  (AIRPORT COMMERCIAL) ZONE, CITYWIDE.

Be approved.

The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:

Yeas:  Commissioner Patrick, Rice, Shaw-Williams, and
  Chairwoman Trejo.

Ms. Wilcox explained there is no appeal process, and that the
recommendation will go directly to the City Council for
consideration.

6B. ZONING CODE AMENDMENT NO. 2022-003 (ZCA-2022-003)

A public hearing to consider a City initiated Zoning Code Amendment
No. 2022-003 (ZCA 2022-003) to modify transportation impact
analysis requirements in conformance with Senate Bill 743.

Mr. Bernard McCrumby, Senior Planner, made the staff presentation
and advised that the Public Works Department’s consultant, Lisa
Trifiletti, Principal at Trifiletti Consulting, is available on the
line for any questions.

Chairwoman Trejo opened the public hearing to the audience to speak
either for or against this project.

FOR/AGAINST:

None (Confirmed by the AT&T Operator).

Chairwoman Trejo asked the Planning Commission if there were any
questions for staff.

Commissioner Shaw-Williams asked staff –
 Will this new method allow for the traffic to flow more
  efficiently?
   Ms. Lisa Trifiletti responded to Commissioner Patrick’s
  question.

Chairwoman Trejo opened the floor for the Planning Commission for
further comments and or questions.

Chairwoman Trejo seeing none, asked the Planning Commission for a
motion.

MOTION:

Commissioner Shaw-Williams made the motion to affirm categorical
exemption EA-CE-2022-085, and adopt a resolution recommending
approval of Zoning Code Amendment No. 2022-003 (ZCA-2022-003), and
was seconded by Commissioner Shaw-Williams, that Resolution No.
1937

(7) NON-PUBLIC HEARING:

7A. PLANNING COMMISSION REVIEW NO. 2022-002 (PCR 2022-002)

A Planning Commission Review to approve a new 350 square-foot
one-story restroom building in Darby Park at 3400 Arbor Vitae
Street.

Ms. Christine Rivera, Assistant Planner made the staff
presentation.

Acting Chairwoman Trejo asked the applicant to give their name and
talk about the project.

Ms. Sabrina Barnes, Director of Parks, Recreation and Community
Services spoke to the Planning Commission via telephone regarding
the project and answered questions from the Planning Commission.

Acting Chairwoman Trejo asked the Planning Commission if there
were any questions for staff.

Commissioner Patrick made the comment, the sooner the better.

Commissioner Rice thanked Ms. Barnes and stated he is looking
forward to seeing the restrooms improve in the City.

Commissioner Rice asked the applicant –
 How soon will the project be completed
  - Ms. Barnes responded to Commissioner Rice’s question.

Commissioner Shaw-Williams thanked Ms. Barnes and stated it was a
great presentation.

Chairwoman Trejo thanked Ms. Barnes for including changing tables.

Chairwoman Trejo closed the hearing and asked for a motion.

MOTION:

Commissioner Rice made the motion to affirm Categorical Exemption
EA-CE-2022-078 and adopt a Resolution approving PCR-2022-002
subject to 6 conditions, and/or add conditions as deemed
appropriate and was seconded by Commissioner Shaw-Williams that

(8) PUBLIC COMMENTS:
None, (Confirmed by AT&T Operator).

Chairwoman Trejo closed the hearings to the public and asked for
the Planning Commission Initiatives.

(9) COMMISSION INITIATIVES:

 Looking forward to Inglewood Jazz Festival.

Commissioner Rice –

 As a forty-three year resident it’s fun to live in Inglewood
